clarification_questions: Since the authors' original recorded data are unavailable, the feasible path is a new emulated measurement: two configurations (baseline vs. +20 ms delay) run under the emulated-netem-v1 runner, measuring flow_completion_time_ms. Before proposing, please confirm: (a) which link directions should receive the 20 ms increment (client-to-server only, server-to-client only, or both directions), and (b) whether 20 ms is the per-direction value or the total round-trip increment?
What bottleneck bandwidth and transfer size (or duration) should be used for the emulated flows, and how many replications per configuration are desired?
Are there any resource or wall-time budget constraints for this pilot (e.g., maximum wall seconds, maximum cost in USD)?
